body: Orchestrator note (acceptance round): Definition of Done fixes on the sprint integration branch, not ticket work: 7a3c80f moved the epic branch-name rule to `src/shared/domain/branchName.ts` so the renderer build stops importing node:crypto (DM-361); 7aa7c70 removed graph.ts's dependency on portable.ts (DM-348), un-exported five in-module helpers added by DM-354/DM-346/DM-360/DM-361/DM-352, refreshed `.tsprune-ignore` (line drift plus two shared exports the web program sees as unused: `withRepoPrefix`, `PacketRepository`), and added a load-tolerant timeout to a DM-356 test.
